description: MainActivity.java defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which sets up the main user interface, manages fragment transactions, handles menu options including toggling a log view, and initializes logging infrastructure.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main launcher activity of the Android app that manages UI components, fragments, menu actions, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ElevationBasicFragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the activity's options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu before display, showing or hiding the log toggle based on device configuration.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the log view when the toggle menu item is selected.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, including wrapping Android's log, filtering messages, and linking to a log display fragment.
